newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 11.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- National statistics office INSEE finds household consumption stronger than expected in view of rising unemployment and flat buying power, forecasts a 2.5 percent rise in consumption for 1996 from 1.8 in 1995.
-- Prices rose 0.4 percent in September after dropping for three consecutive months.
-- Danone considers opening joint-venture breweries in China with local brewer to tackle local markets.
-- EU Commissioner Karel Van Miert says he wants Credit Lyonnais to implement asset sales in France before the EU clears further subsidies for the state-owned bank.

-- Unions at Framatome nuclear-boiler manufacturer worried about plans to merge with Franco-British group GEC-Alsthom, say merger may be a move to bring cash from Framatome to Alcatel Alsthom, GEC-Alsthom's main shareholder, when it bids for Thomson.
-- Electronics group JVC to close down plant in eastern Lorraine region, move it to Scotland.
-- Bouygues to ally with Italian STET in mobile phones, to compete with France Telecom.
